title_zh: 用信件限定祖辈移民展板的描述

scenario.label_zh: 修订家族移民经历展览说明
scenario.goal_zh: 核对人物经历与历史材料，限定有证据支持的影响描述并安排补充出处

context_zh: 卢卡正在为家族移民经历课堂展览撰写说明，海伦老师与他一起查看家族保存的信件和日期。
author: author-phase06-c

sentences.speaker: Luca
sentences.text: I want this panel to be about my ancestor Elena, who moved here in 1912.

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.text: Which part of her life can you support with these letters?

sentences.speaker: Luca
sentences.text: Her youth in the new town. She was nineteen when she arrived, and she describes finding work at a laundry.

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.text: Then focus on that aspect of her experience. Your draft says she changed the whole town, but the letters do not show that.

sentences.speaker: Luca
sentences.text: You are right. They tell us what happened to her, not what happened to everyone else.

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.text: Keep the arrival date and the laundry job. Add the dates of the letters beside those details.

sentences.speaker: Luca
sentences.text: I will remove the claim about the town and put a source note under each quotation.
